facts.text: The resort is set amid 120 hectares of unspoilt nature.
facts.excerpt: Terme di Saturnia Resort is nestled amidst 120 hectares of unspoilt nature

facts.text: The resort includes a spa, a GEO-certified 18-hole golf course and two restaurants.
facts.excerpt: a pluri-awarded spa, a GEO-certified 18-hole golf course, and two restaurants

facts.text: The resort has been in hospitality since 1919.
facts.excerpt: An icon of hospitality and well-being since 1919

facts.text: A hot spring at the centre of the resort feeds the natural pool and all the thermal pools, whirlpools and vascular paths.
facts.excerpt: At the centre of the experience, a millenary and immensely potent Hot Spring that feeds the natural pool from which spring water flows, all the thermal pools, whirlpools and vascular paths.

facts.text: After a 40-year journey underground, the hot spring water emerges at 37.5 degrees Celsius.
facts.excerpt: after a 40-year journey underground, the Hot Spring water emerges at a perfect temperature of 37.5°C

facts.text: The hot spring was well known by the Romans.
facts.excerpt: The Spa harnesses the miraculous properties of a Hot Spring, active for thousands of years and well-known by the Romans.

facts.text: Every Friday evening the Natural Hot Spring stays open until midnight for bathing under the stars.
facts.excerpt: Every Friday evening, the Natural Hot Spring remains open until midnight

facts.text: Stays include unlimited access to the Natural Hot Spring, thermal pools, whirlpools, hydromassage jets and kneipp course.
facts.excerpt: \- Natural Hot Spring, thermal pools, whirpools and hydromassage jets, kneipp course

facts.text: The Roman Bath, with sauna and Turkish bath, is for the exclusive use of resort guests.
facts.excerpt: A place dedicated to the care of the body and the spirit, this balanced space, for the exclusive use of Resort guests, offers an intense detoxification and purification experience between sauna and Turkish bath.

facts.text: A typical Tuscan countryside Casale was restored into an air-conditioned space for relaxation.
facts.excerpt: we have restored a typical Tuscan countryside Casale into an intimate, reserved, air-conditioned space for relaxation.

facts.text: In the Hay Room you breathe the woody fragrance of yellow hay.
facts.excerpt: In the Hay Room you can breathe in the sweet woody fragrance of yellow hay, a natural myorelaxant.

facts.text: Resort guests also have access to the day spa facility, a 20,000 square metre area with thermal pools, whirlpools, sauna, argillarium and kneipp course.
facts.excerpt: Resort guests also have access to the day spa facility, a 20,000 square metre oasis dedicated to wellness with thermal pools, whirpoools, sauna and argillarium, kneipp course.

facts.text: Two of the four thermal pools in the day spa area are reserved for children.
facts.excerpt: Two of the four thermal pools are reserved for children.

facts.text: 1919 Restaurant is a pied dans l'eau restaurant open for lunch and dinner.
facts.excerpt: The _pied dans l’eau_ restaurant is open for both lunch and dinner with ever new proposals based on fresh ingredients and respect for authentic taste.

facts.text: La Stellata is a Tuscan farmhouse trattoria overlooking the hills, serving traditional Tuscan and Maremma dishes.
facts.excerpt: A typical Tuscan farmhouse that overlooks the hills and welcomes you with a proposal of traditional Tuscan and Maremma dishes.

facts.text: Il Bar is a place for a coffee, an aperitif by the spring or a light lunch.
facts.excerpt: it is the ideal place for a coffee, an aperitif by the spring, a light lunch

facts.text: The golf course is a championship par 72, 18-hole course designed to merge with the surrounding hills.
facts.excerpt: Terme di Saturnia Golf is a championship, Par 72, 18-hole course, designed to merge with the surrounding hills, carefully conserving natural habitats.

facts.text: The golf Club House is within the hotel hall.
facts.excerpt: The Club House is within the hotel hall.

facts.text: No insecticides or pesticides are used on the golf course.
facts.excerpt: No insecticides or pesticides are used.

facts.text: Terme di Saturnia has its own team of physician specialists and a blood and genetic analysis center.
facts.excerpt: Terme di Saturnia has its own team of physician specialists, with a fully equipped blood and genetic analysis center

facts.text: The private spa suite in Room 306 has a Jacuzzi, tatami and sensory shower.
facts.excerpt: The private suite in Room 306 is an exclusive space with a Jacuzzi, tatami, and sensory shower

facts.text: The resort's Active Beauty cosmetic line is based on Saturnia Bioplankton, which matures in the thermal waters.
facts.excerpt: thanks to the hyper-fermentation found In Saturnia Bioplankton®, the biogenic treasure which matures in the thermal waters of Terme di Saturnia, Active Beauty, our exclusive cosmetic line was born.

facts.text: An exclusive pet-friendly area is set up on the lawn of the Spring.
facts.excerpt: an **exclusive “pet-friendly” area is set up on the lawn of the Spring**

facts.text: Pets can join guests at the Bar Drink and Food Library and Trattoria La Stellata.
facts.excerpt: You can bring your furry friend at the Bar Drink & Food Library and the Trattoria la Stellata

facts.text: The concierge can arrange wine tastings, guided village tours and tours by e-bike, horseback or hot-air balloon.
facts.excerpt: such as a wine tasting, a guided tour through the villages or a tour by e-bike, horseback or hot-air balloon!

facts.text: Stays include a daily guided morning walk.
facts.excerpt: Daily guided morning walk

facts.text: Rome Fiumicino airport is 150 km from Saturnia.
facts.excerpt: “Leonardo da Vinci” airport – Fiumicino (RM), 150 km from Saturnia.

facts.text: The concierge can book transfers to and from airports or train stations.
facts.excerpt: Our concierge is at your disposal to assist you in booking transfer service to/from airports or train stations.

facts.text: In January 2023, 104 cypress trees were planted along the access path, one for each year of the resort's history.
facts.excerpt: In January 2023, 104 cypress trees were planted along the access path of Terme di Saturnia, one for each year of the Resort’s history

facts.text: La Stellata and 1919 Restaurant were featured in the Falstaff Restaurant Guide Italy 2027.
facts.excerpt: We are proud to announce that two of our restaurants have been featured in the Falstaff Restaurant Guide Italy 2027.

facts.text: The hotel describes the thermal water as unique in the world.
facts.excerpt: A thermal water unique in the world for its extraordinary antioxidant, myorelaxant and transformative power.
